subject: Capital Improvement Project Priorities
overview: The Medford School Committee met as a Committee of the Whole to review facility needs and establish priorities for remaining capital improvement funds. No formal votes were taken, but school administration was guided to continue preparing bid specifications for high school restroom renovations.

items.title: Capital Improvement Plan Priorities
items.summary: School administration presented spending priorities for approximately $816,000 in unspent project funds, leading to committee discussion on high school restroom renovations, HVAC system stabilization, road access, and building infrastructure maintenance.
